sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.35046 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue any appropriate writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ or order declaring the action of respondent no.2 to 3 in not paying the compensation to their lands situated at Bhoothpur vilage, Makthal Mandal, Narayanpet District, totalling to an extent of Ac.19-98 cents, in various survey numbers, the District Collector (LA), Narayanpet District, the Respondent Nos.2 and 3 not paid the compensation amount till today to the petitioners and direct the respondents to pay the compensation as specified under the right to fair compensation and transparency rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 and pass...."
2.

entities.text: right to fair compensation and transparency rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is stated that petitioners are the absolute owners and possessors of agricultural land admeasuring Ac.19-98 cents in Sy.Nos.382, 397, 420 and 376 situated at Bhoothpur village, Maktal Mandal, Narayanpet District.

The case of the petitioners is that the respondents after following the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of Telangana Land Revenue Act, 1317 Fasli and Rules made thereunder, assigned the said land to the petitioners and their names were also recorded in the revenue records and they are also receiving various CVBR, J Wp_35046_2023 investment subsidies under various schemes introduced by the State Government.
It is the further case of the petitioners that the said lands have been acquired for the purpose of Bhoothpur Balancing Reservoir situated at Bhoothpur village, Maktal Mandal, Narayanpet District.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the respondents have not paid the compensation, as per the law laid down by this Court in terms of the judgment of the full bench of this Court in LAO-cum-RDO,
Chevella Division, Domalaguda, Hyderabad v. Mekala Pandu 1.
3.

entities.text:
LAO-cum-RDO,
Chevella Division, Domalaguda, Hyderabad v. Mekala Pandu
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Respondent No.3 filed counter affidavit, inter alia stating that the Executive Engineer, RLISP HW & C Division, Atmakur has given requisition for acquiring land admeasuring Ac.497.01 guntas for the purpose of Bhoothpur Balancing Reservoir at Bhoothpur village, Maktal Mandal, Narayanpet District.

It is further stated that after following the due procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, Award No.23 of 2006 was passed in respect of patta lands 2004(2) ALD 451 CVBR, J Wp_35046_2023 and ex-gratia has also been paid to some assignees, as per G.O.Ms.No.1307 dated 23.12.1993, who made application to the L.A.O., along with required title Documents, but the petitioners have not made any application nor submitted required titled documents and as such the then L.A.O., has not paid ex-gratia to the petitioners.

sentences.text: 4. Sri S.Venkateshwar Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners, vehemently submitted that the petitioners are not only entitled for ex-gratia in terms of G.O.Ms.No.1307 dated 23.12.1993, and in fact they being the land loosers are also entitled for compensation on par with the pattadars under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894, but no compensation has been paid to them.

5. It is case of the respondents that some of the assignees have already received amounts of ex-gratia as per G.O.Ms.No.1307 dated 23.12.1993, therefore, the said assignees, who have received compensation are not entitled for any compensation either in terms of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 or in terms of the Right to Fair CVBR, J Wp_35046_2023 Compensation and Transparency,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, whereas, the specific case of the petitioners is that they have not received any compensation or ex-gratia in terms of G.O.Ms.No.1307 dated 23.12.1993.

entities.text:
Right to Fair CVBR, J Wp_35046_2023 Compensation and Transparency,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As there is no dispute that the lands of the petitioners have been sub-merged into the Bhoothpur Balancing Reservoir, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition directing respondent Nos.2 and 3 to determine the compensation payable to the petitioners in accordance with law within a period of four (04) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
7. As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
